versions.subject: add process_creation_susp_del
versions.detection:
susp_del_exe:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'del '
        - '/f '
        - '/q '
        - '.exe'
susp_del_dll:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'del '
        - 'C:\ProgramData\'
        - '.dll'
condition: susp_del_exe or susp_del_dll
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*del *" CommandLine="*/f *" CommandLine="*/q *" CommandLine="*.exe*") OR (CommandLine="*del *" CommandLine="*C:\\ProgramData\\*" CommandLine="*.dll*")

versions.subject: feat: update cmd based rules
versions.detection:
# Example:
#   del C:\ProgramData\*.dll & exit
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'Cmd.Exe'
selection_del:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'del '
        - 'erase '
selection_extensions:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '\\\*.dll'
        - '\\\*.exe'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\cmd.exe" OR OriginalFileName="Cmd.Exe" CommandLine IN ("*del *", "*erase *") CommandLine IN ("*\\\*.dll*", "*\\\*.exe*")
